contract.task_clause:
Which of the following situations would not impair objectivity, integrity, or independence with respect to an audit client?
Option A: An auditor takes the client’s audit committee to Las Vegas for the weekend.
Option B: An out-of-town client takes the audit engagement team out to dinner at a renowned local restaurant.
Option C: An auditor provides client management with box seats for the season at a major league baseball franchise.
Option D: A client takes the audit engagement team on a two-day ski trip after the audit team worked for two consecutive weekends.
